summary: Iteration 42: Tested photo upload/removal endpoints and additional charts in DonoAssessoriaDashboard. Backend APIs (100% pass), Frontend code review verified all features implemented correctly. UI testing blocked by login session issue in preview environment.

integration_issues.issue: Login button stuck on 'Entrando...' state - token not being stored in localStorage despite backend returning 200 OK. This is blocking UI testing of DonoAssessoriaDashboard but appears to be an environment/session issue, not a code bug.

action_items: Investigate login session persistence issue - backend returns 200 but frontend doesn't store token (may be environment-specific)
critical_code_review_comments: Photo upload/removal implementation is complete with proper validation (file type, size)
Foto da Equipe tab has data-testid='foto-tab' for testing
All 4 new charts implemented: Distribuição por Cidade, Top 5 Atletas, Conquistas da Equipe, Posições nos Rankings
Charts use recharts library (BarChart, ResponsiveContainer) correctly
Upload handler validates file type (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF) and size (5MB max)
Remove photo confirmation dialog present with window.confirm()

success_rate.frontend: Unable to test UI due to login session issue - code review verified implementation

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs for photo upload/removal working correctly. The DonoAssessoriaDashboard page at /minha-assessoria requires role='dono_assessoria' to access. All chart components and Foto da Equipe tab are implemented. Login session seems to have intermittent issues in preview environment - backend returns 200 OK but token not stored in localStorage.
